newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Energy Q1 boosted by rate increases.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Energy Q1 boosted by rate increases.

text.p: Peoples Energy Corp on Friday said rate increases that went into effect a year ago helped boost net income in the fiscal first quarter ended December 31 by almost four percent to $37.5 million.
The higher rates took effect midway through the fiscal first quarter ended December 31, 1995. For that period, the company posted net income of $36.1 million.
Revenues in the most recent quarter rose to $387.1 million from $317.6 million.
The natural gas holding company said the latest results reflected the full benefits of the rate increases, offset by a decline in natural gas deliveries from energy-conservation efforts.
Its shares were up 1/8 at 33-5/8 in early afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
